interpretation: Fixed-support scoring removes the candidate-dependent denominator bug and makes normal/reversed controls comparable.
The estimand is now the intended one: does the supplied action trajectory explain the observed image flow?
The pilot is heterogeneous: RCS is strong on WorldDrive and Epona, borderline on DriveVA, and weak on DriveWAM.
No formal MAS/RCS promotion is justified until thresholds and calibration are frozen on held-out real video and controls are reported with confidence intervals.
claim_boundary: Pilot evidence only; not a published benchmark score and not a causal future-to-action claim.
